title: Lanthanide Complexes of Tritopic Bis(hydrazone) Ligands: Single-Molecule Magnet Behavior in a Linear Dy3(III) Complex

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Gd(NO3)3·6H2O (0.10 g, 0.22 mmol) and 2poap (0.050 g, 0.12 mmol) was gently heated in 20 mL of methanol for 20 min. A yellow precipitate formed and was filtered off and dried. The precipitate was dissolved in DMF and MeOH (2 mL each), and the solution was layered with ether. Yellow crystals appeared after 1 day. Yield: 0.022 g, 20%. The crystal structure shows two coordinated DMF molecules; the dried bulk sample appears desolvated.

synthesis.procedure: A solution of La(ClO4)3·6H2O (0.14 g, 0.25 mmol) in 10 mL of MeOH was added to a suspension of 2pomp (0.050 g, 0.12 mmol) in 20 mL of MeOH with stirring. A 10 mL solution of sodium benzoate (0.050 g, 0.34 mmol) in MeOH was then added, and the mixture was refluxed for 6 h. The solution was filtered and the filtrate left undisturbed for crystallization. Yellow crystals appeared after 2 weeks. Yield: 0.080 g, 33%.

synthesis.procedure: A solution of Gd(NO3)3·6H2O (0.10 g, 0.22 mmol) in 10 mL of MeOH was added to a suspension of 2pomp (0.050 g, 0.12 mmol) in 20 mL of MeOH with stirring. The mixture was refluxed for 8.5 h. A pale-yellow solid formed, was washed with MeOH, and dried. The precipitate was dissolved in DMF and MeOH (2 mL each) and layered with ethyl ether. Yellow crystals appeared after 1 day. Yield: 0.080 g, 36%.

properties.summary: Linear Gd3 complex. At 0.1 T, χT = 25.2 cm3·K·mol−1 at room temperature (three Gd(III); spin-only 23.6), rising slightly to 25.9 at 4 K then dropping a little. At 0.01 T, χT is nearly constant (~24.5) down to 6 K then 24.2 at 2 K. Possible weak intramolecular ferromagnetic exchange (J positive and small, <0.2 cm−1) but isotropic linear S=7/2 trinuclear fitting was not reported because a negative Weiss correction larger than J was required.

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.10 g, 0.28 mmol) and 2pomp (0.050 g, 0.12 mmol) was gently heated in 20 mL of MeOH for 40 min and then stirred at room temperature for 1 h. A yellow precipitate was filtered, dried, and dissolved in DMF. The solution was layered with ether. Yellow crystals appeared after 1 day. Yield: 0.047 g, 20%.

properties.summary: Linear Dy3 helicate shows field-induced SMM behavior. χT falls from 42.0 cm3·K·mol−1 at 300 K to 28.4 at 2 K (theoretical 42.5 for three uncoupled Dy(III)). Magnetization at 2.5 K and 7 T is 20.2 μB (vs 30.0 μB expected), with nonsuperimposing M vs H/T plots indicating anisotropy. Zero-field ac (10–1500 Hz, 2–10 K) shows frequency dependence but no full peaks (QTM). Under 1800 Oe dc, χ″ vs T peaks below 5 K. Arrhenius fit: Ueff = 14 K, τ0 = 2.28 × 10−6 s.
